why: Series fields, StackedArea, ChartMarks, Meter zones and 1.x Bars props change shape in v3; without codemods argo (G5), weatherorb (G4) and shutterflow (1.x) hand-edit hundreds of sites. This is the series half of the chart codemods.
what: Series-side transforms and the flag-only list in tools/migrate-v3/charts/series/, plus one 1.x fixture app for migrate --check. No library code, no rows.
concept: docs/v3/concepts/charts-cards-kanban.md section 10 (the table is the spec) and 4 (series-field table); migration-release.md 7 (the report is a worklist).
contract: Use the report shape and row-id rule of v3-charts-7a (tools/migrate-v3/charts/report.ts). Ids are fixed here; v3-charts-7c writes one row per id.
exemplar: tools/migrate-v3/charts/card/ (v3-charts-7a): transform layout, cases.ts, report use.
change: Register series transforms under the existing `charts` subcommand. Yes rows: sf-format (formatValue to format), sf-weight (strokeWidth and strokeOpacity: under 1.5 to quiet, over 2 to strong, between flagged), sf-dash (dashed to dash), sf-axis (axisSide to axis), sf-opacity (fillOpacity to opacity), stacked-area (StackedArea to Lines with stack, area fade), chart-marks (ChartMarks marks to CartesianChart.custom, wrap), meter-zones ({from,to} to {to}, tone for colour), bars-1x (1.x Bars getX, getValue, positiveBars, chartId, xTicks to x, series mark bar, cursor). Flag-only rows: sf-auto-domain (autoMaxFloor, autoMinCeil, autoPad), statstrip-statcell (StatStrip, WidgetHeader), deltabadge-polarity (a compile error on purpose, never guess up-good), donut, mirrored-bars, dual-panel, chart-curve, fold-bands. Cases in series/cases.ts, one in/out pair per Yes id and one flagged case per flag id, test fails on a missing id. fixtures/bars-1x-check/before imports Bars getX; after is its codemod output. Tests ship failing first. No rule, no skill snippet.
commits: One non-package commit in one PR: feat: add series codemods. Conventional, empty scope, no attribution.
acceptance: bun test tools/migrate-v3/charts/series passes, including the every-id-has-a-case check.
Running the charts subcommand on fixtures/bars-1x-check/before writes a tree equal to fixtures/bars-1x-check/after (diff -r prints nothing).
Each flag-only id yields a flagged report entry and no rewrite (asserted in the test).
git diff --name-only origin/master...HEAD lists only paths matching owns.
out_of_scope: ChartCard codemods (v3-charts-7a), rows (v3-charts-7c), migrate --check wiring, the release gate, layout and import codemods.
